news.q: The Rays avoided a World Series sweep by beating the Brewers 4-3 on a walk-off in Game 4. How many innings did the game last?
news.fact: Pinch-hitter Ben Williamson's single to right brought home the winning run.

news.q: Rubin Observatory just revealed 2026 ED138, a possible new dwarf planet. It's the largest object found beyond Neptune in about how many years?
news.fact: It's thought to be roughly 370 to 930 miles across.

In what year did the Titanic sink?

easy.q: How many Oscars has Leonardo DiCaprio won?
easy.fact: His only win so far came for The Revenant, at the 2016 ceremony.

easy.q: How many U.S. states have a Pacific Ocean coastline?
easy.fact: California, Oregon, Washington, Alaska and Hawaii.

easy.q: How many Super Bowls did Tom Brady win?
easy.fact: Six with New England and one with Tampa Bay.

medium.q: What is the most clubs a golfer can carry in competition?
medium.fact: Carry a 15th and the Rules of Golf hand you a penalty.

medium.fact: The flight from New York to Paris took about 33 and a half hours.

medium.q: In what year did Entourage premiere on HBO?

medium.q: How many countries are in Africa?
medium.fact: South Sudan, independent since 2011, is the newest.

hard.q: How many episodes of Breaking Bad were made?

hard.q: How tall is Denali, in feet?
